name: Awesome Car Rental & Booking
author: Abdullah Nahian

sections.description:
Awesome Car Rental & Booking is a lightweight WordPress plugin for managing cars and bookings from a single admin dashboard.

Unlike traditional plugins, it:
– Uses only one admin menu
– Hides all Custom Post Type menus
– Provides a clean tab-based interface
– Is fast, secure, and extendable

Perfect for small to medium car rental businesses.

Features

  • Single admin menu: Car Booking
  • Car management (Add, list, status, rent)
  • Booking management (Customer, dates, days, total)
  • Automatic rent calculation
  • Revenue report with date filter
  • No Custom Post Type menus
  • Clean WordPress admin UI
  • Developer-friendly code structure

Usage

  1. Open Car Booking → Add Car
  2. Add your cars with rent and availability
  3. Go to Add Booking
  4. Select car, pickup & return date
  5. Booking total will calculate automatically
  6. View reports from Report tab

License

This plugin is licensed under the GPLv2 or later.
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate Awesome Car Rental & Booking from the Plugins page
  3. Go to Admin → Car Booking
sections.faq:
Does this plugin create CPT menus?

No. All CPT menus are completely hidden.

Can I extend this plugin?

Yes. The code is clean and developer-friendly.

Is this suitable for production use?

Yes. It follows WordPress coding standards.

Does it support frontend booking?

Not yet. This will be added in future versions.
